# Mashable ME

> > Mashable ME delivers entertainment, tech product reviews, and lifestyle coverage across streaming platforms like Netflix, Apple TV+, Prime Video, and Hulu.

This is the Middle East edition of Mashable, featuring expert contributors covering TV and film criticism, consumer technology reviews, work-from-home solutions, and cultural commentary. The site focuses on practical product recommendations, streaming entertainment analysis, and modern lifestyle topics.

## Key Topics

- Entertainment reporting and TV/film reviews
- Streaming platforms (Netflix, Apple TV+, Prime Video, Hulu)
- Product reviews and tech journalism
- Work-from-home gear and small business
- Smartwatches and consumer electronics
- VPNs and crypto wallets
- Mental health and sexual wellness
- Fantasy and sci-fi coverage
- Film criticism and Tomatometer ratings
- Remote work culture
- Animation and pop culture
- Gift guides and shopping recommendations

## Entertainment & Streaming Coverage

- [Belen Edwards](https://me.mashable.com/u/belen-edwards): Entertainment reporter Belen Edwards: TV/film reviews and streaming coverage

- [Georgia Dodd](https://me.mashable.com/u/georgia-dodd): Tech journalist Georgia Dodd: smartwatches, gift guides & product reviews

## Work & Business

- [Kaitlyn McInnis](https://me.mashable.com/u/kaitlyn-mcinnis): Kaitlyn McInnis: home office reviews, WFH gear & small business coverage
